219 Cadets Commissioned as SAF Officers

Minister Teo expressed her hope that the newly minted officers would carry the responsibility of defending Singapore and safeguarding our way of life. She said, “This evening, Singapore entrusts you with the privilege of command. Tomorrow, you begin earning the trust that gives it meaning.”

The parade marked the completion of 38 weeks of rigorous training in the Officer Cadet School. The realistic training conducted during the course sharpened the cadets' combat, planning and leadership skills. The newly commissioned officers will go on to assume command, instructional or staff appointments in the SAF. Also present at the parade were Chief of Army, Major-General Cai Dexian and senior SAF officers, as well as families and friends of the newly commissioned officers.
